input_sources: canonical BIF files via flux_discover_files() (GRP_ERA_DOWN rows)
notes: One row per site x ERA_VARIABLE (8 variables x 781 sites = 6248 rows), from each site's currently-canonical BIF file's GRP_ERA_DOWN group (the task's 'AUXMETEO metadata'; GRP_ERA_DOWN is the literal BIF group name, not literally 'AUXMETEO'). Raw ERA_SLOPE/ERA_INTERCEPT/ERA_RMSE/ERA_CORRELATION values as extracted, -9999 sentinel not recoded to NA (kept literal so a reader can see the sentinel directly).
